naslov.en: The list of the fourth class.

lede.sr: Dvadeset sedam zavedenih prisustava, redom kojim je nastavnik vodio spisak. Dvadeset jedan rad je fotografisan — ukupno 87 fotografija; šest zapisa nosi prisustvo bez fotografija i stoji u delu „Šta se čeka”. Posle prototipa snimljene su fotografije iz udruženja, gde su radovi dalje razrađivani, dokumentovani i testirani.
lede.en: Twenty-seven recorded attendances, in the order the teacher kept the list. Twenty-one works were photographed — 87 photographs in all; six entries carry attendance without photographs and stand in the „What we wait for” part. After the prototypes came the photographs from the association, where the works were developed further, documented and tested.

description.sr: Nastavnikov spisak četvrtog časa (23.10.2026), zapisivan redom vođenja spiska; broj uz zapis je broj fotografija tog rada. Čas je nastavak rada na prototipovima: razrada, dokumentovanje i testiranje u udruženju. Fotografije su na telefonu nastavnika (Galaxy S23 FE, /Internal storage/DCIM/Camera); niz počinje snimkom 20261023_112141.jpg. Prvo idu fotografije prototipa, pa fotografije iz udruženja. Uz spisak su zavedene i ispravke ranijih zapisa trećeg časa.
description.en: The teacher’s list of the fourth class (23 October 2026), recorded in the order the list was kept; the number beside an entry is that work’s photograph count. The class continued the prototype work: development, documentation and testing at the association. The photographs are on the teacher’s phone (Galaxy S23 FE, /Internal storage/DCIM/Camera); the sequence begins with 20261023_112141.jpg. The prototype photographs come first, then those from the association. Corrections to earlier third-class records are filed with the list.

napomena.sr: Brojevi su brojevi fotografija, ne ocene. Zapisi bez fotografija nisu izostavljeni: oni nose zavedeno prisustvo i stoje u delu „Šta se čeka”, sa onim što je za taj rad najavljeno.
napomena.en: The numbers count photographs, not grades. Entries without photographs are not omitted: they carry recorded attendance and stand in the „What we wait for” part, with what was announced for that work.

nizNapomena.sr: Svaka fotografija snimljena na četvrtom času biće objavljena uz rad kome pripada, čitana redom slikanja — fotografije još nisu prenete sa telefona. Broj uz svaki zapis jeste broj fotografija koje je taj rad dobio; prvo idu fotografije prototipa, pa fotografije iz udruženja.
nizNapomena.en: Every photograph taken at the fourth class will be published with the work it belongs to, read in shooting order — the photographs have not yet been transferred from the phone. The number beside each entry is the number of photographs that work got; the prototype photographs come first, then those from the association.

udruzenjeNalazi.sr: Prototipi su u udruženju dalje razrađivani — rad se nastavio na licu mesta, ne samo na času.
udruzenjeNalazi.en: At the association the prototypes were developed further — the work continued on the spot, not only in class.

udruzenjeNalazi.sr: Radovi su dokumentovani: fotografije iz udruženja idu u istom nizu, posle fotografija prototipa.
udruzenjeNalazi.en: The works were documented: the photographs from the association follow in the same sequence, after the prototype photographs.

udruzenjeNalazi.sr: Prototipi su testirani sa korisnicima udruženja.
udruzenjeNalazi.en: The prototypes were tested with the association’s users.

analizaUdruzenja.sr: Posle rada na prototipovima otišli smo u udruženje: prototipi su dalje razrađivani, dokumentovani i testirani sa korisnicima. Fotografije iz udruženja slede u istom nizu, posle fotografija prototipa.
analizaUdruzenja.en: After the prototype work we went to the association: the prototypes were developed further, documented and tested with users. The photographs from the association follow in the same sequence, after the prototype photographs.

napomena.en: the student number was corrected on 23 October 2026 on the teacher’s confirmation: today it was written with its parts swapped; the year is 2024, as for the whole cohort.

sta.sr: Zapis 15: danas je doneta skica, ne prototip — jedna fotografija. Naziv rada nije zabeležen; prototip se očekuje sledeći čas.
sta.en: Entry 15: a sketch was brought today, not a prototype — one photograph. The work’s title was not recorded; the prototype is expected at the next class.

sta.sr: Zapisi 15 i 26 nemaju zabeležen naziv rada, iako imaju fotografije.
sta.en: Entries 15 and 26 carry no recorded work title, although they have photographs.

sta.sr: Na spisku posete udruženju stoji jedno ime koje nije na ovom spisku radova — osamnaesto prisustvo tog dana, bez zavedenog rada. Prisustvo je zavedeno u registru posete; rad se čeka.
sta.en: The association-visit list carries one name that is not on this list of works — an eighteenth attendance that day, without a filed work. The attendance is recorded in the visit register; the work is awaited.

sta.sr: Evidencija prisustva na predavanju do sada nije vođena. Ovaj spisak zavodi one koji su se pojavili u spisku radova i na poseti; ko je bio na času a nije zaveden, iz njega se ne vidi. Ako nedostaješ, javi na času.
sta.en: Attendance at the lecture has not been kept so far. This list records those who appeared in the list of works and on the visit; whoever was in class without being recorded is not visible here. If you are missing, say so in class.

sta.sr: Tri rada snimljena jedan za drugim — poslužavnik sa papirnim lopticama i gumicom, bela ploča sa slamčicama kroz koju je provučen konac, i ogledalska ploča sa sivim tačkama i kanapom — nose u spisku nazive „praćka”, „igra sa užetom” i „stubići”. Redosled snimanja slaže se sa redosledom spiska, ali nijedan naziv se sam po sebi ne vidi na kadru; potvrda koji naziv ide uz koji predmet se traži.
sta.en: Three works photographed one after another — a tray with paper balls and an elastic band, a white board with straw segments threaded by a cord, and a mirrored sheet with grey dots and a twine — carry the titles “praćka”, “igra sa užetom” and “stubići” in the list. The shooting order matches the list order, but no title is visible in the frame itself; confirmation of which title belongs to which object is requested.

sta.sr: Uz zapis 15 stoji da je donet crtež, a ne prototip. Jedan kadar (12:20:14) zaista pokazuje olovkom crtanu skicu tri varijante kružne staze, i taj kadar je pripisan tom zapisu. Tri kadra odmah posle njega (12:40:40–12:40:43) pokazuju lavirint od crnih slamčica zalepljenih na sivu ploču — pripisani su sledećem zapisu sa fotografijama. Potvrda ovog reza se traži.
sta.en: Entry 15 is recorded as a drawing brought to class, not a prototype. One frame (12:20:14) indeed shows a pencil sketch of three variants of a looped track, and that frame is attributed to that entry. The three frames right after it (12:40:40–12:40:43) show a maze of black straws glued to a grey board — these are attributed to the next entry with photographs. Confirmation of this cut is requested.

sta.sr: Zapis 6 je jedini rad ovog časa koji nije fizički predmet: kadrovi pokazuju veb-aplikaciju sa klavijaturom koja se svira pokretom ruke pred kamerom, i autora kako je pokazuje. Zato je u registru upisan kao digitalan rad, a ne kao prototip od materijala.
sta.en: Entry 6 is the only work of this class that is not a physical object: the frames show a web application with a keyboard played by hand movement in front of the camera, and its author demonstrating it. It is therefore recorded in the register as a digital work, not as a prototype made of materials.

sta.sr: Rad „putanja” sa trećeg časa pripada autorki zapisa 4 ovog spiska. Na spisku trećeg časa taj niz kadrova stajao je uz ime iz prethodnog reda; atribucija je ispravljena u registru radova, a fotografije nisu dirane.
sta.en: The work “putanja” from the third class belongs to the author of entry 4 of this list. On the third-class list that frame sequence stood beside the name in the preceding row; the attribution is corrected in the work register, and the photographs were not touched.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 23.10.2026: četiri kadra koja su na trećem času stajala pod nazivom „brza putanja” prikazuju „3d lavirint”, rad autorke zapisa 8 ovog spiska. Rad je u registru preimenovan i pripisan njoj; folder fotografija zadržao je staro ime da otisci ostanu proverivi.
sta.en: Closed on 23 October 2026: the four frames that stood under the title “brza putanja” in the third class show “3d lavirint”, the work of the author of entry 8 of this list. In the register the work is renamed and attributed to her; the photograph folder kept its old name so the fingerprints stay checkable.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno 23.10.2026: dva kadra rada „2d lavirint” sa trećeg časa pripadaju autoru reda 20 tog spiska, koji nije na ovom spisku. Prezime je zavedeno kako ga je nastavnik danas naveo; broj indeksa stoji kako je dostavljen 21.10. i potvrđuje se na času.
sta.en: Closed on 23 October 2026: the two frames of the work “2d lavirint” from the third class belong to the author of row 20 of that list, who is not on this list. The surname is recorded as the teacher gave it today; the student number stands as supplied on 21 October and is confirmed in class.

sta.sr: Posledica razdvajanja: ime iz reda 21 spiska trećeg časa ostalo je bez fotografisanog rada, jer su sva tri niza kadrova pripala imenima iz narednih redova. Naziv „brza putanja” pripisan mu je uslovno — nastavnik ga je naveo kao verovatan, ne kao potvrđen. Red stoji otvoren u spisku trećeg časa.
sta.en: A consequence of the separation: the name in row 21 of the third-class list is left without a photographed work, because all three frame sequences went to the names in the following rows. The title “brza putanja” is attributed to it provisionally — the teacher gave it as likely, not as confirmed. The row stands open in the third-class list.

sta.sr: Broj indeksa zapisa 27 ovog spiska ispravljen je: danas je bio zapisan sa zamenjenim delovima, a godište je 2024, kao kod cele generacije. Spisak trećeg časa je uz isto ime od početka nosio tačan broj, pa je pitanje zatvoreno.
sta.en: The student number of entry 27 of this list was corrected: today it was written with its parts swapped, while the year is 2024, as for the whole cohort. The third-class list carried the correct number beside the same name from the start, so the question is closed.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno: broj indeksa zapisa 8 je onaj iz spiska trećeg časa. Razlika zapisana danas bila je greška u prepisu, ne prijava studentkinje.
sta.en: Closed: the student number of entry 8 is the one from the third-class list. The difference written today was a transcription slip, not a report by the student.

sta.sr: Dva rada sa trećeg časa nose nove nazive: zapis 9 ovog spiska vodi se kao „Brojkice” umesto ranijeg „sudoku”, a zapis 25 kao „taktilna kutija” — taj rad je na trećem času bio bez naziva. Raniji nazivi ostaju u istoriji registra.
sta.en: Two works from the third class carry new titles: entry 9 of this list stands as “Brojkice” in place of the earlier “sudoku”, and entry 25 as “taktilna kutija” — that work stood without a title in the third class. The earlier titles stay in the register’s history.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno: godište koje odudara od generacije 2024 nije greška. Predmet slušaju i studenti koji nisu položili godinu, pa takav broj indeksa ostaje kako je zapisan.
sta.en: Closed: a year that differs from the 2024 cohort is not an error. The course is also attended by students who have not passed the year, so such a student number stands as recorded.

sta.sr: Zatvoreno: „hansgadget” i „starlight” sa trećeg časa su dva rada istog studenta, a ne jedan rad sa devet kadrova. U registru stoje kao dva zasebna rada, sa šest odnosno tri fotografije.
sta.en: Closed: “hansgadget” and “starlight” from the third class are two works by the same student, not one work with nine frames. In the register they stand as two separate works, with six and three photographs.

sta.sr: Spisak sa posete udruženju istog dana zaveden je kao zaseban registar: sedamnaest imena, redom kojim ih je nastavnik zapisao. Fotografije iz udruženja još nisu prenete, pa analiza posete čeka.
sta.en: The list from the same day’s association visit is filed as its own register: seventeen names, in the order the teacher wrote them. The photographs from the association have not been transferred, so the visit analysis waits.

sta.sr: Tri zapisa dobila su drugačiji broj fotografija nego što je rukom zapisano, jer kadrovi pokazuju drugi predmet nego što bi rez po zapisanom broju dao: zapis 14 ima jedan kadar umesto dva (drugi je skica zapisa 15), zapis 22 sedam umesto pet, zapis 26 dva umesto tri (kadar pre njih je poster zapisa 25). Ukupan broj od 87 fotografija nije se promenio.
sta.en: Three entries received a different photograph count than the handwritten one, because the frames show a different object than a cut by the written numbers would give: entry 14 has one frame instead of two (the second is entry 15’s sketch), entry 22 seven instead of five, entry 26 two instead of three (the frame before them is entry 25’s poster). The total of 87 photographs did not change.

prenos.sr: Fotografije su prenete sa telefona 24.10.2026. (Galaxy S23 FE, /Internal storage/DCIM/Camera): 87 kadrova prototipova i 31 kadar posete udruženju, razdvojenih pauzom od 29 minuta u nizu snimanja. Kadrovi posete još nisu objavljeni.
prenos.en: The photographs were transferred from the phone on 24 October 2026 (Galaxy S23 FE, /Internal storage/DCIM/Camera): 87 prototype frames and 31 frames from the association visit, separated by a 29-minute pause in the shooting sequence. The visit frames are not published yet.

presek.sr: Niz je prvo razvrstan po predmetu koji se na kadru vidi, pa tek onda upoređen sa brojevima iz spiska; tri reda su zbog toga dobila drugačiji broj. Poreklo svakog kadra — ime fajla i vreme snimanja — stoji u data/cas-04/poreklo-kadrova.json.
presek.en: The sequence was first grouped by the object visible in the frame and only then compared with the numbers in the list; three rows therefore received a different count. Each frame’s provenance — file name and capture time — is in data/cas-04/poreklo-kadrova.json.
